subject: english-language
title: Formal and Informal
welcome_lead: Speech changes when the audience changes. Learn the levels.
meta_desc: KS3 English Language adventure on formal and informal register.
final_note: You can now flex register for context and audience.

walkthroughs.body_html: A job interview needs formal register; a chat with friends uses informal register. Both can be 'correct' for context.
Codeswitching is shifting between language varieties — from dialect to standard, or one language to another, mid-conversation.
Real speech is full of fillers ('um', 'like'), tag questions ('right?') and discourse markers ('so'). They organise live talk.
